data.name: Herbalist Roman
data.detailed_description:
Begin your work in a realistic herbalist simulator and, as a newly appointed envoy of the Herbalist Guild, take over the workshop left behind by your former master.

Your most important tool is the herbal book. Thanks to it, you will learn which macerations and remedies to prepare in order to help your clients.

Trade, grow herbs, and venture into the forest to gather ingredients needed for treatments. Every case requires knowledge and the right approach.

Drebor is a Slavic settlement on the border of Polish, Czech, and German lands, where life follows its own rhythm. Recently, however, more and more people speak of changes coming from the outside. Christianity is no longer a choice, but a necessity. Rejecting it draws the attention of the margrave and the Church, who are watching settlements like Drebor ever more closely.

People will come to you not only for healing, but also with requests that are not always simple. The way you help them will affect both their personal stories and how life in all of Drebor will change.
